subject.title: Support Azure Foundry GPT Realtime Talk via gateway relay

question: Which Azure Realtime credential and endpoint contract should OpenClaw support before implementation?
rationale: The fix must choose a credential boundary and redirect/auth behavior for Azure API keys, SecretRefs, and possible Entra support; automation should not decide that security contract from source inspection alone.

options.title: API-key GA relay first
options.body: Support the Azure GA gateway-relay path for server-side API-key/SecretRef credentials now, constrain redirect/auth behavior, and track Entra or managed identity as follow-up.

options.title: Include Entra in first pass
options.body: Delay implementation until the first Azure Realtime design also covers Entra or managed identity alongside API keys.

options.title: Defer for live Azure proof
options.body: Keep the issue blocked until maintainers can provision Azure GPT Realtime quota and validate the exact endpoint behavior before choosing the contract.

recommendation.title: API-key GA relay first
recommendation.body: Support the Azure GA gateway-relay path for server-side API-key/SecretRef credentials now, constrain redirect/auth behavior, and track Entra or managed identity as follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete carried the GA Realtime provider work that left the Azure deployment path intentionally separate.
